The `.editorconfig` has been created at the repository root. Here's a summary of what each setting does and why it matches the existing files:

| Section | Setting | Value | Why it matches |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[*]` (all files) | `charset` | `utf-8` | All files are ASCII (UTF-8 compatible) |
| `[*]` | `end_of_line` | `lf` | All files use Unix-style LF line endings |
| `[*]` | `insert_final_newline` | `true` | Every file already ends with a trailing newline |
| `[*]` | `trim_trailing_whitespace` | `true` | No trailing whitespace exists in any file |
| `[*.py]` | `indent_style` / `indent_size` | `space` / `4` | Python code uses 4-space indentation (PEP 8) |
| `[*.md]` | `indent_style` / `indent_size` | `space` / `4` | Markdown files use spaces where indented |
| `[*.ini]` | `indent_style` / `indent_size` | `space` / `4` | Config files use spaces around `=` with no tabs |
